validation.notes: Repaired the split cwd->session-dir encoding: packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts getDefaultSessionDirPath() now encodes ':' (was /[/\\]/g) and packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() now encodes '\\' (was /[/:]/g); both sides now use the canonical /^[/\\]/, then /[/\\:]/g contract that packages/agent/src/harness/session/jsonl/repo.ts sessionDirectoryName() and packages/coding-agent/test/sdk-session-manager.test.ts already state. No API, import graph or unrelated behaviour changed. .prale-eval/regression.mjs links the real session-manager.ts, migrations.ts and utils/paths.ts via .prale-eval/subject.mjs (boundary fakes only for config.ts, chalk, utils/text.ts, core/keybindings.ts and @earendil-works/pi-ai with a deterministic uuidv7; no time, randomness or network) and asserts across the producer/consumer boundary: (1) getDefaultSessionDir(cwd) and SessionManager.create(cwd).getSessionDir() equal <agentDir>/sessions/--<encoded>-- for '/work/proj/alpha', '/work/proj/weird/windows:C\\Users\\alice\\src' and a Unicode cwd with ':' and '\\'; (2) after migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() each legacy ~/.pi/agent/*.jsonl is gone from the agent root, present at the canonical dir, and found by the real reader SessionManager.list(cwd), SessionManager.continueRecent(cwd) and loadEntriesFromFile with cwd/id/entry order preserved, the malformed middle line skipped and Unicode text intact; (3) migrated bytes are identical to the pre-migration bytes and reads never rewrite the file; (4) two extra migration runs keep exactly one file per cwd with unchanged bytes and no duplicates; (5) a pre-existing session file at a colliding target keeps its bytes and the colliding legacy file is left in place. Scratch store lives in .prale-eval/.tmp-regression/ and is removed at the end. Mutation check: restoring session-manager.ts alone to its faulty baseline fails with AssertionError 'session manager must encode /work/proj/weird/windows:C\\Users\\alice\\src into --work-proj-weird-windows-C-Users-alice-src--'; restoring migrations.ts alone fails with AssertionError 'migrated file must exist at .../sessions/--work-proj-weird-windows-C-Users-alice-src--/session-windows.jsonl'; both are assertion failures (exit 1), not crashes, and exit 0 with the repair. Limitation: node_modules is not installed, so vitest/tsc and the repository test suite could not be run; the regression instead type-strips and evaluates both production modules (real syntax check) against the real filesystem and real session reader.
